rationale: The narrative names the right core method (consensus clustering, 80% subsampling, k=2..10, delta-area, ARI/NMI and contingency against condition, within-condition re-clustering), but only Step 1 is actually specified; the clustering steps lack a permuted/null comparison, use only 200 resamples, omit PAC and item/cluster consensus, and never tabulate library size or depth against clusters as confounders, nor explicitly select top-variable genes. QC is solid (library sizes, centroid distance, flag-not-drop policy, PCA by condition) and the CPM>=1 in 10% filter is reasonable, but the integer-fraction test is fragile since Salmon raw counts are commonly fractional and could wrongly route real counts to a TPM branch. The limma discriminator step states no formula, alpha or BH, and enrichment is added without a universe, version, or size window when the question does not call for it; versions and reporting of the stability evidence are only promised in outline.
